In court, the suspect's charge of DUI was amended to physical control. The suspect's charges of driving on a suspended license, tinted windows, resisting arrest, and open container were later dismissed after she pleaded not guilty. The suspect pleaded not guilty to misuse of 911 but pleaded no contest to the remaining charges.
